BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. The Chicago Zoning Ordinance is amended by changing all of the RS-3,
Residential Single Unit (Detached House) and B3-1, Community Shopping District
symbols and indications as shown on Map No. 16-H in the area bound by:

South Winchester Avenue; the alley next north of parallel to West 69" Street; South

east of and parallel to South Marshfield Avenue; West 69"" Street; South Marshfield
Avenue; the alley next south of and parallel to West 69" Street; South Wolcott Avenue; a
line 75 feet south of and parallel to West 69"" Street; the alley next west of and parallel to
South Wolcott Avenue; the alley next south of and parallel to West 69" Street; the alley
next east of and parallel to South Damen Avenue; a line 80 feet south of and parallel to
West 69" Street; South Damen Avenue; the alley next south of and parallel to West 69"
Street; a line 174.02 feet west of and parallet to South Damen Avenue; and West 69"
Street,

to those of a B2-3, Neighborhood Mixed-Use District.

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be effective after its passage and publication.
